mapper.select: SELECT hanzi FROM NC.mdr_char WHERE pinyin=#{syll} AND tone=#{tone} AND (in_3500=1 OR in_4800=1)
SELECT info, id AS mandarin_id FROM NC.mdr_char WHERE CAST(hanzi AS BINARY)=CAST(#{sc} AS BINARY) OR CAST(hanzi AS BINARY)=CAST(#{tc} AS BINARY) ORDER BY id

SELECT DISTINCT mapping.mandarin_id FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi h JOIN JSON_TABLE(h.pinyin, '$[*]' COLUMNS (mandarin JSON PATH '$.mandarin')) py JOIN JSON_TABLE(py.mandarin, '$[*]' COLUMNS (mandarin_id INT PATH '$')) mapping WHERE h.id <> #{excludeHanziId}
AND mapping.mandarin_id IN #{id}
